briefing.headline: US-China AI chip export controls tighten as GPT-5 training runs accelerate

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with GPT-5, Claude 4.5 and Gemini 3 all in late training. Compute constraints and export controls dominate headlines while multi-agent deployments expose new attack surfaces.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's o4-preview shows 18% gains on agentic benchmarks. Anthropic ships Claude 4.5 with extended context. xAI Colossus cluster hits 300k H100s; DeepSeek-V4 open-weights release triggers global scrutiny.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. CISA issues new guidance on autonomous agent sandboxing.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC Arizona fab ships first 2nm wafers to Microsoft. Google TPU v6 pods reach 10 exaflops. Stargate supercluster construction delayed by power grid constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will export controls slow Chinese AGI progress more than they accelerate allied domestic capacity?
